stories.title: Russian Drone Strikes Kyiv Science Academy and Hospital, Causing Casualties
stories.summary: A Russian drone strike hit the National Academy of Sciences in central Kyiv, resulting in at least one death and multiple injuries. The attack caused significant damage to the historic building, with flames visible as people attempted to escape. This incident is part of a broader pattern of drone strikes targeting Ukraine's capital, which has seen increasing violence in recent days.

stories.title: Taylor Swift Makes History at MTV VMAs, Dedicates Award to Dolly Parton
stories.summary: At the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards, Taylor Swift became the most-awarded artist in the event's history. She dedicated her top prize, Video of the Year for 'The Fate of Ophelia,' to Dolly Parton, who was honored during the ceremony. Madonna also had a notable night, winning multiple awards, including Artist of the Year.

stories.title: SpaceX's Starship Achieves First Orbital Flight
stories.summary: SpaceX's Starship successfully reached orbit for the first time during its 14th test flight, marking a significant milestone for the company and NASA. The mission, which launched from Texas, is crucial for future plans to land humans on the moon and beyond. However, the test flight concluded earlier than anticipated.

This decision follows a civil lawsuit filed by the alleged victim against seven members of the Chi Phi fraternity, claiming she was drugged and raped at their house.

stories.summary: President Donald Trump announced plans for a $15 billion steel plant to be built by Mesabi Metallics in eastern Iowa. The White House described the project as the largest steel plant in U.S. history, marking the first major steel facility constructed in the country since the 1960s.

stories.title: SpaceX's Starship Launches into Orbit but Ends Early
stories.summary: SpaceX's Starship, a powerful spacecraft, launched into orbit for the first time but concluded its flight prematurely. The spacecraft reentered over the Pacific Ocean and splashed down north of Hawaii approximately three hours after its launch from Texas. The mission aimed for a 10-hour flight with six laps around Earth to demonstrate readiness for NASA's Artemis moon program.

stories.title: Hurricane Nolo Moves Away from Hawaii, Threats Remain as Hurricane Polo Approaches Mexico
stories.summary: Hurricane Nolo is moving away from the Hawaiian islands, located approximately 365 miles south-southwest of Honolulu. Despite its movement, the threat of heavy rain, flash flooding, and strong winds continues in areas still recovering from previous storms. Meanwhile, Mexico's Baja California is preparing for Hurricane Polo, which is expected to impact the region soon.
